description:
Get the before/after values for a single detected Code Monitor change, addressed by url + createdAt (both from a list_code_monitor_changes row). Returns changes: a list of { type, property, before, after } — one entry per on-page field that changed in that snapshot (title/canonical/meta/robots/headings/hreflang/status code/OpenGraph/Twitter/Analytics/Tag Manager; before/after are raw values, arrays for multi-valued fields). Pass changeType (one of the change_types labels, e.g. "Title") to return just that field. Returns not_found when no change exists for that url+createdAt on this property, invalid_change_type for an unknown changeType, feature_not_available when the plan lacks Code Monitor. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Before/after diff for a detected change on the pricing page.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","url":"https://example.com/pricing","createdAt":"2026-06-15 03:00:00"}
```
name: get_code_monitor_change
title: Code change detail
